title: PHY102 Physics Lab Makeup Session Notice
inputText:
DEPARTMENT OF APPLIED PHYSICS
Course: PHY102 Engineering Physics Practicals

Notice for Absentee Students:
The makeup laboratory practical session for students with verified medical absences will be held on February 30, 2026 (Room 104, Physics Annex) from 09:00 to 12:00.

Attendance is mandatory to obtain passing marks in the practical component.
